name: 99114 · Colville, WA
findings: ZIP 99114 (Colville) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 33 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99114 (Colville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99114 (Colville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
